name: 1-start.jpg
caption: Golden hour on the Palm Strip: chase-cam behind the sculpted Solaris GT, the low sun glowing through the palms over wet asphalt, Art Deco hotels with corner drums and neon on the right, the pier wheel over the bay, and the full live HUD.

name: 2-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star sunset pursuit: two interceptors on the supercar's bumper, the police helicopter's searchlight cone pinning it, a V roadblock ahead, siren light on the wet boulevard, tyre smoke and the wanted stars.

name: 3-action.jpg
caption: Mission 04 on Coral Pier: over-the-shoulder SMG firefight under the neon Ferris wheel, tracers, muzzle flash and hit sparks, the gang behind crates and drums, panicking bystanders, and the mission objective on the HUD.

name: 4-night.jpg
caption: Midnight on the Strip: the cyan supercar on rain-slicked asphalt mirroring the neon hotels, palms and skyline under a starry violet sky, with the mission card, minimap and city-progress badge.
